Final report: 13 of 14 tests pass. `test_discount_three_items` fails, and I left it failing on purpose.

I implemented `line_total` and `invoice_total` in `src/invoice.py` as the README specifies. That means `Decimal` arithmetic with `str()` conversion, ROUND_HALF_UP to 2 places, `float` returns, and a `ValueError` for bad `qty`, `discount_pct` or `unit_price`.

The failing test asserts `line_total(10.0, 3, 10) == 27.30`. The specification gives 10 × 3 × (1 − 10/100) = 27.00, which is what my code returns. The test's expected value looks wrong. A 10% discount on 30.00 can't give 27.30. I couldn't make the test pass without breaking the specification, and I didn't change anything under `tests/`. The test needs correcting to 27.00. Alternatively, if 27.30 is really intended, the README formula needs clarifying.
